description.value: Caffé Divano is a locally owned neighbourhood café in Coquitlam, part of a small Tri-Cities family of cafés founded by Patrick and Lisa Beecroft. The Coquitlam location has been operating since 2013, serving handcrafted beverages and food made daily from scratch using simple, natural ingredients. The café is connected to the Beecrofts' Gabi & Jules bakery, which supplies all baked goods across the Divano locations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms this is an active, locally-owned neighbourhood café at 3003 Burlington Drive, Coquitlam, with phone 604-474-3113 matching OSM. The site explicitly states 'Dine In & Take Out,' confirming takeout service. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Caffe Divano' (no accent) while the website consistently uses 'Caffé Divano' (with accent on the é).
OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 06:00-18:00; Sa-Su 07:00-18:00) differ from website hours (Mon-Fri 6:30am–5pm; Sat-Sun 7am–5pm) — OSM data may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active café with dine-in and takeout, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before including in the directory.
